spec.name: Furniture Skull Candelabra
spec.description: A tall black iron candelabra anchored in an ivory skull, with three stepped orange candles and small amber flames. Painted eye sockets, nasal cavity and teeth give the compact skull its character. All geometry is axis-aligned, physically connected and contained within the requested bounds.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tall black iron candelabra with ivory skull base and three orange candles. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
